name: You Are a Liar
summary: Party bluffing game where one guesser tries to spot which players are reading false statements.
rules_text: Place TRUE, LIE, and FINGER piles in center. Each player starts with one FINGER in their winnings. Choose a starting guesser. Each round the guesser closes eyes. Each other player secretly takes one card from either the TRUE pile or the LIE pile, but as a group at least one LIE must be taken. Guesser opens eyes. Going clockwise from guesser's left, each holder reads their statement aloud while hiding the TRUE/LIE symbol. Immediately after each reading, the guesser may accuse them of lying by placing a FINGER card from the center in front of them; this decision is final. After all readings, scoring: for each correctly accused LIE, guesser keeps that FINGER in their winnings. Incorrect FINGER accusations return to center. For each TRUE card wrongly accused, guesser loses one FINGER from their winnings to the center if they have one. Return used story cards to bottom of their piles. Rotate guesser clockwise. Game ends when center FINGER pile is empty; player with most FINGER cards in winnings wins.
rating_reason: Bluffing liar game with hidden info, fits engine perfectly.
